name: z0dream
description: Zoom into anything. Recursively turn generated images into explorable ultra-high-resolution worlds.

interface.longDescription: Create an image, select any detail, and recursively dream deeper into it. z0dream synthesizes new detail at each zoom level instead of stretching old pixels.
defaultPrompt: Use z0dream to create a world I can keep zooming into.
Open z0dream and let me dream deeper into an image.
Create an ultra-detailed recursive image with z0dream.
